page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
playlist_matches = []
query = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res) if isinstance(res, list) else None)
    if not res:
        break
    for p in res:
        if p.get('title','').strip().lower() == query.strip().lower():
            playlist_matches.append(p)
    page_index += 1
print('total_exact_matches', len(playlist_matches))
print('titles', [p['title'] for p in playlist_matches])
print('ids', [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlist_matches])

songs = playlist['songs']
print('playlist_song_ids', [s['id'] for s in songs])
# Fetch play_count for each song
song_stats = []
for s in songs:
    sid = s['id']
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': info.get('title'),
        'artists': [a.get('name') for a in info.get('artists', [])],
        'play_count': info.get('play_count')
    })
print('song_stats')
for st in song_stats:
    print(st['song_id'], st['title'], st['artists'], 'play_count', st['play_count'])
max_play = max(st['play_count'] for st in song_stats)
print('max_play_count', max_play)
# choose first occurrence in playlist order
most_listened = None
for st in song_stats:
    if st['play_count'] == max_play:
        most_listened = st
        break
print('most_listened', most_listened)
